$comment: MCP tool manifest for BlinkMark. Satisfies FR-052: a machine-readable description of the operations available to agents, their inputs, outputs, and required permissions, discoverable without human documentation. Served over Streamable HTTP from the API container and returned by tools/list.

serverInfo.name: blinkmark
serverInfo.description: Read and comment on short-lived HTML and Markdown drafts on behalf of a signed-in user.

notes: The agent's permissions are exactly the represented user's, never broader (FR-046).
On-Behalf-Of requires an inbound user assertion, so no app-only credential exists and an agent cannot act for a signed-out user (FR-055).
Withdrawing user access or consent revokes the agent immediately, because authority lives in the token and nothing is stored (FR-050).
Denials are identical to denials for the user acting directly (FR-047).

tools.name: list_my_files
tools.description: List the represented user's live, unexpired files. Returns exactly what that user would see in the interface.

tools.name: read_file_content
tools.description: Retrieve a file's content as structured, machine-readable text blocks with anchor offsets. Returns the same normalized projection that comment anchors resolve against, not a rendered visual page (FR-051).

errors.description: Unknown file, or its expiry has passed. Expired content reads as absent (FR-032).
The represented user may not access this file (FR-047).

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List all comments on a file, including orphaned ones with their original quoted context.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Attach a comment to a passage of a file, or reply to an existing comment. The comment is authored by the represented user with this agent recorded as the acting client, and that attribution is visible to human readers (FR-048).

exact.description: The passage being commented on. Must come from read_file_content output.

errors.description: Agent request rate exceeded so interactive users are not degraded (FR-054).

tools.$comment: The author field is deliberately absent from the input schema. Author identity comes from the token; a supplied value would be ignored (FR-005, FR-023).

tools.name: extend_retention
tools.description: Extend a file's expiry. Permitted only when the represented user owns the file, and never beyond 30 days from original upload.

errors.description: The represented user does not own this file (FR-029).
Requested expiry is beyond 30 days from upload; existing expiry unchanged (FR-028).

notProvided.reason: Deliberately omitted in this phase. Upload is a human act of sharing; agent-side upload adds quota and content-provenance questions with no requirement behind it. If added, FR-087 requires it to count against the represented user's quota and rate limit.
Download is owner-only (FR-071) and an agent acting for a non-owner must be refused (FR-072). Exposing it as a tool invites agents to attempt it routinely and be denied.
No product interface exposes audit entries in this phase, and no role grants access (FR-070, clarification Q1).
Presence is transient and never the record of access (FR-067, FR-068). An agent reading it would encourage exactly the misuse FR-068 forbids.
